Cross-cutting · Durability / corrosion / exposure / service life

832 resources · Last updated November 25, 2026

What's new Topics Key issues Resources Research gaps Change log Get updates Reactions Calculator

Key points

  • Partial coverage: Exposure, steel passivation and curing govern durability; do not generalize short laboratory mortar tests to long service life.
  • Nov 12 backfill of mechanism classics (DOI/abstract level): ASR (Diamond 1975; Chatterji 1979; Hobbs 1988 book; Swamy & Al-Asali 1988; Fournier & Bérubé 2000), DEF (Scrivener & Taylor 1993; Diamond 1996; Taylor et al. 2001), carbonation models (Papadakis 1991/2000), chloride transport (Page et al. 1981; Andrade 1993; Thomas & Bamforth 1999), sulfate/thaumasite (Mehta 1983; Cohen & Mather 1991; Crammond 1985/1995) and RILEM CDF/CIF frost tests (R1627–R1884, 87 records).
  • Nov 20 backfill: chloride binding and chloride threshold reviews, sea-sand/seawater concrete and FRP bars in seawater concrete, calcium leaching, carbonation-depth prediction, biogenic sulfuric-acid (sewer) corrosion, salt scaling, ASR mitigation with SCMs, colour change and image analysis of fire-damaged concrete, retry-list chloride/carbonation reports (R3580–R4038, 90 records). DOI/abstract level only.
  • Nov 25 backfill: reinforcement corrosion monitoring and cement-type effects, sulfate attack (gypsum, seawater vs groundwater), coupled freeze–thaw/carbonation/chloride service life, marine chloride diffusion, and French/Italian durability theses and books (R4596–R4902, 68 records). DOI/abstract or record-page level only.
